reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents Forsage as a business opportunity requiring viewers to provide ETH, install and fund a wallet, and activate progressively costly slots linked to increased revenue. The presentation reinforces the request with upline diagrams, direct wallet payments, and claims of members receiving substantial ETH, while describing the project as extremely safe. It also states that success is not guaranteed, and the available video evidence does not establish that any payment or return occurred.

citations.quote: when you register with forces with eth0.05 money you open these two programs at the same time
every close slot that the value is twice as expensive as the previous slot and of course, creating two times as much revenue as usual
Forces X3 you receive a direct payment of 100% to your eth wallet
or the other member's Spillover to your team
The more slots you activate, the more ETH potential that can be received

opening.argument: Judge the presentation as a discussion of a risky business opportunity, not a promise of effortless returns. The speaker expressly says there is no guarantee of success and describes effort as necessary. Even the case for activating more slots is phrased in terms of greater potential, not a fixed payout. Those qualifications matter when assessing whether the viewer is being promised an assured result.

citations.quote: it is necessary to be understood that VORCES is not a cheap fast scheme there is no guarantee of success
if you want to supply Ethereum with a lot of money there are some things you have to do
The more slots you activate, the more ETH potential that can be received

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening identifies an ETH entry cost, rising slot prices and asserted wallet payments. Those establish what the speaker says the arrangement requires and how it is meant to work; they do not establish that returns are guaranteed. The speaker's explicit qualification is important context for interpreting the revenue language, and the absence of a verified payment cannot by itself show that a payment claim is false.

citations.quote: when you register with forces with eth0.05 money you open these two programs at the same time
there is no guarantee of success

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The disclaimer does not undo the solicitation. The speaker directs viewers to fund a wallet for registration and slot activation, while explaining that higher-priced slots are supposed to produce more revenue. A warning that success is not guaranteed qualifies the pitch, but it does not change the paid, tiered mechanism being promoted.

citations.quote: save enough Ethereum there to register and then activate the number of slots you want one per one
every close slot that the value is twice as expensive as the previous slot and of course, creating two times as much revenue as usual

opening.argument: The substantial middle of this video teaches how the two matrix programs are structured: it distinguishes their rows and positions, then walks through where payments would go as positions fill. That is operational explanation a viewer could use to evaluate the proposal. The speaker also directs viewers to a more detailed explanation of how its marketing works. A tutorial can describe a payment system and its advertised benefits without the explanation itself proving that a viewer will receive those benefits.

citations.quote: in x3 program there have three positions in one row in x4 program you have 2 rows two positions in the first row and four positions in the row
You received the payment 100% from the second row from positions three, four,-5 directly to your wallet while position 6 opens the next metric slot
for more detailed information about how VORCES chain marketing works please watch our video until the end

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats the matrix explanation as evidence of solicitation, but describing an entry amount, slot progression and payment paths is also how one explains a system's operation. The wallet-payment language states the proposed rule; neither that wording nor a diagram verifies a completed transfer. The question is whether the explanation itself establishes deceptive solicitation, not whether the subject involves money.

citations.quote: in each program there are 12 slots
Forces X3 you receive a direct payment of 100% to your eth wallet

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is not detached instruction about matrix design. The speaker tells viewers to install a wallet, fund it for registration, activate slots and contact the person who supplied the video. The explanation of positions serves that participation request; the lack of verified transfers makes the asserted returns less substantiated, not the request less promotional.

opening.argument: The description calls Forsage a crowdfunding platform where members support one another, and the speaker describes a wallet-to-wallet arrangement rather than saying an operator holds members' funds centrally. The presentation also says transactions can be checked on the blockchain. Those are claims to scrutinize, not independent proof of safety, but they leave a narrower evidentiary question than the opening suggests: the cited entry fee and matrix rules do not, on their own, demonstrate a diverted deposit or a guaranteed return.

citations.quote: FORSAGE is a next-generation decentralized Crowdfunding platform where members network and support each other ...
FounderForces doesn't take or store crypto members in the center
You can easily verify all transactions in the Ethereumereum blockchain
there is no guarantee of success

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening's strongest point is that ETH buys access to increasingly costly slots, with payments described through team positions and spillover. That distinguishes the arrangement from a simple retail purchase, but it does not show where any viewer's ETH actually went or verify the claimed outcomes. Direct-wallet and transparency claims should be tested, not assumed true or false from the speaker's description alone.

citations.quote: or the other member's Spillover to your team
100% of all ETH payments are instantly sent straight to your VJS team.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A claim that funds move directly between wallets does not make the underlying arrangement ordinary commerce. The speaker says ETH registration opens two programs, describes payments tied to positions, and links activating more slots to greater earning potential. The crowdfunding description and claimed transparency do not supply an independently verified transaction or change those participation incentives.
